description.value: The UFV Library serves the University of the Fraser Valley community across campuses in Abbotsford, Chilliwack, and Mission, offering access to print and digital collections, research assistance, and study spaces. As an academic library on a large university campus, it primarily serves students and faculty but is accessible to community members via guest access. A touring cyclist passing through Abbotsford would find a large institutional building with campus surroundings.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (15 spaces) at 30m; lockers (3 spaces, secure) at 31m. Total: 18 spaces, 3 secure.
